scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only products of exactly two complete graph factors of order at least two.
It does not establish root locations, unimodality, or log-concavity.
Unindexed equivalent enumeration of cross-avoiding edge subsets remains a priority risk.
Finite verification complements, but cannot replace, the uniform structural proof.
title: Exact total-domination polynomial of the categorical product of two complete graphs
